metadata.baseline_definition: Pessimistic cumulative retail-energy-provider loss over 2025-2050 used as the optimization input scenario

definitions.a: Maximum modeled fraction of cluster loss that resilience investment can avoid
definitions.b: Investment scale parameter controlling diminishing returns, measured in $M
definitions.ROI: Modeled avoided cumulative loss divided by investment budget; not accounting ROI or IRR
definitions.marginal_ROI: Incremental avoided loss divided by the incremental budget between adjacent tested caps
definitions.cluster: An energy-source-specific group of Texas power plants mapped to the nearest GFDL climate grid centroid

known_qualifications: $43.1B is cumulative over 2025-2050, not annual loss.
The $5B Moderate reference budget is selected from a discrete tested grid using thresholds; it is not a unique continuous optimum.
The Pessimistic $0.1B selection is a fallback after no tested point met all thresholds.
Source ROI, saturation, horizon, and discount inputs remain project assumptions until their underlying citations are recovered.
The project log's worked example says $15M avoided per $1M-year, while the implemented natural-gas input is $0.15M; the implementation is exported as canonical.
Monte Carlo independent normal shocks are a sensitivity mechanism, not an estimated joint probability model.
